name: The Infinity Saga
description: Twenty-three MCU films charting the rise of the Avengers, the Infinity Stones, and the conflict with Thanos.

name: Iron Man Trilogy
description: Tony Stark’s evolution from weapons manufacturer to self-sacrificing armored hero.

name: Captain America Series
description: The Captain America legacy from Steve Rogers’ wartime origin to a new bearer of the shield.

name: Avengers Series
description: Earth’s mightiest heroes assemble for escalating threats spanning Ultron, Thanos, Doomsday, and Secret Wars.

name: Guardians of the Galaxy Trilogy
description: A cosmic found family grows from mismatched outlaws into guardians willing to risk everything for one another.

name: Raimi Spider-Man Trilogy
description: Sam Raimi’s three-film portrait of Peter Parker learning the cost and responsibility of being Spider-Man.

name: Spider-Verse Trilogy
description: Miles Morales crosses animated dimensions and challenges the idea that every Spider-Person must follow the same story.
